headline: Dozens of ride-hail drivers, union members and faith leaders rallied in Washington, D.C., against a bill that would allow Waymo and other robotaxis in the city.
score_reason: Local protest over a pending bill; no decision yet.
importance_line: Ride-hail drivers fear losing income, one saying up to $1,000 a month, while the article does not say when the Council will vote or how it will decide.
summary: WTOP reports that protesters gathered outside the John Wilson Building on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026 against a bill that would cap each robotaxi operator at 200 vehicles until 1 Jan 2028 and set rules for automated driving levels three to five. The bill's sponsor, Council member Charles Allen, says it presents "an opportunity to improve traffic and consumer choice in the District."
notes: Read via WTOP instead of the NBC4 video page.
